column3: 7-line subtree standing order: notes are agent-written RFCs; every new note triggers a supersession check whose qualifying implemented triplets are archived in the same PR, partial supersessions stay active and cross-linked, and archived/ is frozen history and never current authority.

Generated bilingual sidecar for README.md/README.zh.md: one YAML entry per heading section keyed by the English heading-slug path with a 16-hex en and zh block hash, header states the scope and the "pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write" regeneration command; section-scoped so independent edits merge.

The 125-line canonical Agent Note spec: path-encoded lifecycle+class+date layout, closed six-class vocabulary with no INDEX.md, creation and consolidation criteria, the three-lifecycle body skeletons, mandatory "## Alternatives considered" with a dated pre-2026-07-05 grandfather comment, and the archival/deletion policy for the hash-sealed frozen tree.

Chinese counterpart of the Agent Note spec, structurally identical to the English file; adds manual <a id> anchors so in-document section links keep the English slugs, keeps the machine-checked header tokens in English, and mirrors the deletion, archival, grandfather-comment and lifecycle-move rules.
